inlines.text: Gemini 4 Carbon 现已开放使用

blocks.text: 今天，我们面向开发者、企业、科研人员和普通用户推出 Gemini 4 Carbon。Carbon 是我们目前最强的模型，在网络安全能力以及跨复杂知识工作、软件工程和科学推理的长程智能体工作流上均达到前沿水平。

inlines.text: 今天，我们面向开发者、企业、科研人员和普通用户推出 Gemini 4 Carbon。Carbon 是我们目前最强的模型，在网络安全能力以及跨复杂知识工作、软件工程和科学推理的长程智能体工作流上均达到前沿水平。

blocks.text: 两周前，我们通过 Fairwind 计划向一批网络安全防御人员发布了 Carbon。继近期推出 Gemini 4 Argon 之后，Carbon 把前沿又向前推进了一步。对于大多数软件工程和知识工作，Argon 仍是理想之选；而 Carbon 专为考验模型智能极限的任务打造，例如复杂的多步骤编码与调试，以及开放式的科学研究与发现——它会比 Argon 消耗更多 token，以便充分探索、深入推理并运行更长的验证循环。

blocks.text: 更强的科学与数学推理能力

inlines.text: 更强的科学与数学推理能力

blocks.text: Gemini 4 Carbon 在物理、数学和生命科学领域的推理表现显著提升，能够综合实验数据、检验假设，并逐步推理多步骤的领域难题。对药物毒性研究公司 Axiom Bio 而言，Carbon 目前是转化科学领域性能领先的模型，发现了他们此前未曾发现的新型毒性机制。Axiom 正将生产环境的科学分析和智能体迁移到 Carbon 与 Argon 上，以加速更安全药物的研发。

blocks.text: Google 各团队的研究人员已在 Google Antigravity 中使用 Carbon 来加速工作：

inlines.text: Google 各团队的研究人员已在 Google Antigravity 中使用 Carbon 来加速工作：
研究人员构建了一个名为 AlphaProof Code 的新型智能体验证框架，并将其用于一项重大安全挑战：
用数学方法证明 Signal 加密协议底层实际代码的正确性
。研究人员使用 Carbon 及其他模型，将安全目标转化为数学定理。随后，AlphaProof Code 智能体利用 Carbon 生成数百万行 Lean 代码（Lean 是一种用于编写数学证明的计算机语言），在数周内帮助证明了关键安全属性——而这项任务历来需要专家团队耗费数年。这一结果表明，Carbon 有望实现可扩展的形式化验证，而形式化验证长期被视为构建安全软件的黄金标准。
仅提供实验室记录和原始数据，Carbon 就超越了常规分析，发现了难以解读的数据异常，并据此诊断出湿实验室中细微的实验假象，例如深孔板中自动混匀不充分的问题，从而显著提升了可重复性。此外，Carbon 改进了色谱峰解卷积方法，并发现了研究仪器中的微量样品残留，大幅加快了新测定方法的开发，并缩短了计算与实验台之间的反馈循环。

AlphaFold 3 等结构预测模型利用进化近缘序列的多重序列比对（MSA）来推断氨基酸链的折叠方式。因此，它们往往难以处理研究不足、在标准数据库中匹配序列极少的病毒、微生物和真核蛋白质。在多智能体环境中，研究人员利用 Gemini 4 Carbon 自主地在 PB 级未注释序列档案、环境与病毒序列目录以及 3D 结构数据库中寻找远缘同源序列。例如，在 CASP17 盲测集的 7 个低同源蛋白质家族中，Carbon 平均将检索到的同源序列数量提高了 40 倍，无需重新训练就大幅增加了结构预测模型可用的信息。更广泛的基准测试仍在进行中，但解决这一上游搜索瓶颈，有望为蛋白质组中难以表征的区域建模提供一条有前景的路径。

blocks.text: 模型安全与保障方面的进展

inlines.text: 模型安全与保障方面的进展

blocks.text: 随着每一款新模型发布，我们都会根据模型能力同步加强安全与保障缓解措施、智能体滥用防范、模型对齐和危害削减。

inlines.text: 随着每一款新模型发布，我们都会根据模型能力同步加强安全与保障缓解措施、智能体滥用防范、模型对齐和危害削减。

blocks.text: 由于 Gemini 4 Carbon 引入了更强的网络能力，我们在 Argon 的强大安全与保障体系基础上进一步加固，以增强对滥用和提示词注入的抵御能力。

inlines.text: 由于 Gemini 4 Carbon 引入了更强的网络能力，我们在 Argon 的
基础上进一步加固，以增强对滥用和提示词注入的抵御能力。
缓解前沿安全滥用风险：

我们加强了滥用防护措施，帮助确保更强的防御推理能力不会被转化为攻击风险。在注入 ExploitBench 和 CyScenarioBench 的模拟网络攻击测试环境中，Carbon 拦截了自适应红队智能体 99% 的攻击轨迹，该智能体能在每次被拦截后反复调整攻击计划。Carbon 的防护措施将单次尝试的突破率降至仅 0.8%（Argon 为 3.1%）。在 Gray Swan 的测试中，我们的防护措施还将自动化网络攻击查询成功率降至 2.17%，而 Argon 为 9.86%。Trajectory Labs 的外部测试在 132 小时、超过 13,000 次请求中未发现任何新的通用越狱。
促进安全且对齐的模型交互：
在发布 Carbon 时，我们展示了模型全生命周期内监控标记率所衡量的对齐性显著提升，以及数据捏造现象的减少。新结果显示，在我们 375 项任务的智能体诚实性基准测试中，它通过了 92% 的任务（Argon 为 70%）——在 98% 的情况下拒绝填补缺失的实验数据，并在 68% 的情况下标记出方法学缺陷。

inlines.text: 保护用户免受间接提示词注入攻击：
两周前我们分享过，Carbon 在 Gray Swan IPI 基准测试中实现了 0% 的提示词注入攻击成功率——这是首次达到该里程碑。与此同时，我们知道提示词注入的鲁棒性仍是需要持续改进的领域。我们的高级自动化红队测试继续在此推进极限，并表明模型在某些分布下面对复杂攻击仍有改进空间。这为我们持续将模型安全性推进到下一个前沿提供了数据。

blocks.text: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows across complex knowledge work, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.

blocks.text: Two weeks ago, we released Carbon to a set of cybersecurity defenders via our Fairwind Program. Following our recent launch of Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon pushes the frontier even further. Argon remains the ideal choice for the majority of software engineering and knowledge work, while Carbon is built for tasks that test the limits of a model’s intelligence like complex, multi-step coding and debugging and open-ended scientific research and discovery — using more tokens than Argon to explore thoroughly, reason deeply, and run extended verification loops.

blocks.text: Carbon performs exceptionally well on engineering tasks that require multi-agent collaboration like multi-package migrations, cross-subsystem root-cause investigations, and complex architectural redesigns. For web app development, it runs build-and-verify loops, recovers from errors, and checks both its code and the rendered UI to produce complete, working applications. Stronger visual design, spatial reasoning, and attention to environmental detail also carry over to 3D game development and creative coding.

blocks.text: Frontier cybersecurity capabilities

Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber delivers our strongest cybersecurity capabilities to date, giving security teams the end-to-end intelligence they need in protecting critical software. When accessed through the Fairwind Program, Carbon leads on key benchmarks across finding (SEC-bench Pro), exploiting (ExploitGym), and patching (CWE-bench v1) vulnerabilities: inspecting software, tracing how flaws can be chained together across systems, and generating verified root-cause patches.

blocks.text: Stronger scientific and mathematical reasoning

Gemini 4 Carbon shows strongly improved performance in reasoning across physics, math, and life sciences, synthesizing experimental data, testing hypotheses, and reasoning through multi-step domain problems. For drug toxicity research company Axiom Bio, Carbon is now the leading model in performance for translational science, finding novel mechanisms of toxicity they hadn’t found previously. Axiom is now moving their production scientific analyses and agents to both Carbon and Argon to unlock the creation of safer drugs.

inlines.text: Researchers across Google have been using Carbon in Google Antigravity to accelerate their work:
Researchers built a new agentic framework for formal verification called AlphaProof Code and put it to work on a major security challenge:
mathematically proving the actual code underlying the cryptographic protocol of Signal

. Using Carbon alongside other models, our researchers translated security goals to mathematical theorems. AlphaProof Code agents then used Carbon to generate millions of lines of code in Lean, a computer language for writing mathematical proofs, helping them prove key security properties in weeks — a task that historically takes expert teams years. The result indicates Carbon’s potential to unlock scalable formal verification, long considered a gold-standard approach to building secure software.

: Provided with only lab notebooks and raw data, Carbon went beyond standard analysis to surface hard-to-interpret data anomalies, which it used to diagnose subtle wet lab experimental artifacts such as incomplete automated mixing in deep wells, leading to substantially improved reproducibility. Moreover Carbon improved methods to deconvolute chromatography peaks and caught trace sample carryover in research instruments, significantly accelerating the development of new assays and tightening the feedback loop between computation and the bench.

Structure prediction models like AlphaFold 3 use Multiple Sequence Alignments (MSAs) of evolutionary relatives to help infer how amino acid chains fold. As a result they often struggle on understudied, viral, microbial, and eukaryotic proteins that have very few matches in standard databases. Working in a multi-agent setup, our researchers used Gemini 4 Carbon to autonomously discover remote homologs across petabase-scale unannotated sequence archives, environmental and viral sequence catalogs, and 3D structure databases. For example, across 7 low-homolog protein families from the CASP17 blind test set, Carbon increased the number of homologs retrieved by 40-fold on average, greatly increasing the information available to structure prediction models without need for retraining. While broader benchmarking is still underway, addressing this upstream search bottleneck potentially offers a promising path toward modeling hard-to-characterize regions of the proteome.

blocks.text: Progress in model safety and security

inlines.text: Progress in model safety and security

blocks.text: With each new model release, we continue to strengthen our safety and security mitigations, agentic misuse prevention, model alignment, and harm reduction proportionately with model capability.

inlines.text: With each new model release, we continue to strengthen our safety and security mitigations, agentic misuse prevention, model alignment, and harm reduction proportionately with model capability.

blocks.text: Because Gemini 4 Carbon introduces stronger cyber capabilities we build on Argon’s strong safety and security stack to fortify robustness to misuse and prompt injection.

inlines.text: Because Gemini 4 Carbon introduces stronger cyber capabilities we build on Argon’s
to fortify robustness to misuse and prompt injection.

We’ve strengthened our misuse safeguards to help ensure stronger defensive reasoning does not translate into offensive risk. In simulated cyberattack testing environments seeded with ExploitBench and CyScenarioBench, Carbon blocked 99% of attack trajectories from our adaptive red-teaming agent that can iteratively revisit its attack plans after each block. The Carbon safeguards lowered the per-attempt breach rate to just 0.8% (down from 3.1% on Argon). Our safeguards also lowered the automated cyberattack query success rate to 2.17% in Gray Swan’s testing, compared to 9.86% on Argon. And external testing by Trajectory Labs found zero new universal jailbreaks across 132 hours and over 13,000 requests.
Promoting safe and aligned model interactions:

When we announced Carbon, we showed significant improvements in alignment as measured by our monitor flag rates across the model’s lifecycle, as well as reductions in data fabrication. New results show that on our 375-task agentic honesty benchmark, it passed 92% of tasks (compared to 70% for Argon) — declining to fill in missing experimental data 98% of the time and flagging methodological flaws 68% of the time.

inlines.text: Protecting users from indirect prompt injection attacks:

Two weeks ago, we shared that Carbon achieved a 0% prompt injection attack success rate on the Gray Swan IPI benchmark — marking the first time that milestone has been reached. At the same time, we know that prompt injection robustness remains an area for continued improvement. Our advanced automated red teaming continues to push the limits here and has shown that models could be further improved against sophisticated attacks in some distributions. It provides the data for us to continuously advance our models’ security to the next frontier.
